integrity: No independent audit or external validation is asserted; exact program and complete proof are provided for reproducibility. Source release date is the first arXiv posting, not the later revision date.
scientific_limitations: Only the family generated by a, 2a-1, 4a-3 and 8a-7 for integers a>=8 is treated; the infinite theorem is symbolic, and finite computational checks provide corroboration only. Equivalent unindexed prior work is possible. The isolated a=15 instance is a special case of an earlier repunit-constrained family.
title: Pseudo-Frobenius spectra of four-generator negative repunit semigroups
